scope: single-scene interactive vision-agent takeover feasibility test; not a success-rate estimate
controller: assistant decisions from three RGB images and robot proprioception through REST tools
control_interface: bounded world-frame EEF translations and gripper OPEN/CLOSE; DP can be cancelled or resumed
dp_history: updated after each action; preserved between uninterrupted DP commands; reset after EEF correction
baseline_scene_result: 600.ckpt failed at 800 actions in official isolated evaluation
video: three views; action-time samples at 5 fps, idle periods omitted; wall timestamps in video-frames.jsonl
